• AI automation agencies often struggle with sustainability, while productized services offer recurring revenue and better scalability

The service:
• Create 10 pieces of Facebook ad creative monthly
• Optimize Google Maps listings
• Build directory listings

Use AI to:
• Generate ad scripts with Perplexity
• Create images with ChatGPT
• Make videos with HeyGen

Price: $2-3K/month 

2) Facebook Ads for Beauty E-commerce

Beauty brands CONSTANTLY need fresh ad creative as ads get stale FAST.

The service:
• 20 ads per month
• Competitor analysis
• Performance tracking

Use AI to:
• Research product pain points
• Generate UGC-style videos with MAKEUGC
• Create product demos

Price: $3-5K/month 

Pro tip: Show your work BEFORE they hire you by creating sample ads for potential clients!

3) Social Media for Nutrition Coaches

Nutrition coaches are CRUSHING IT right now - serving 100+ clients monthly!

The service:
• Daily social posts
• AI-generated food images
• Client success stories
• Lead magnets (recipe books)

Measure success by impressions and leads generated.

Price: $2K/month 

4) Lead Magnets for Webinar Companies

Did you know over HALF of B2B marketers host webinars? But most struggle with:
• Getting registrations
• Driving attendance
• Repurposing content afterward

The service:
• Turn webinars into ebooks/whitepapers
• Create lead magnets

Price: $2-3K/month 

5) Data Analytics Agency

Companies are DROWNING in data but have NO IDEA what to do with it!

The service:
• Unlimited data analytics for SMBs

• On-demand insights

Use tools like:
• Claude with MCP

• Looker Studio

Price: $2-4K/month 

KEY INSIGHT: The best productized services have these traits:

• RECURRING revenue (not project-based)
• MEASURABLE results tied to client revenue
• SCALABLE delivery using AI tools
• Clear ACQUISITION strategy (YouTube case studies, LinkedIn content)

This beats AI automation agencies EVERY TIME.

6) BONUS INSIGHT: Voice AI is the NEXT FRONTIER 
Cody and I discussed how companies are creating branded voice agents with PERSONALITY:

• NY bagel shops using the founder's accent
• Pizza places with authentic "NY attitude"
• Medical companies using AI to answer complex questions

tweets.text:
I'm telling you one of the biggest reasons you're not where you want to be is because you're deeping shit too much.

I fell into this trap and was overthinking listicles, advertorials, VSLs (longer form ads), etc.

If I just sat there and cooked some up, saw how they performed, then iterated on them, I'd be 10x further than I am rn.

Instead I saw them as some big, daunting tasks so just kept putting them off - or I'd test something once, not see any success and just move on.

Now I purposely move fast so I don't have time to overthink how 'complicated' something is and our ad hit rate is way higher.

Sometimes you just gotta get out of your own way🫥
